source: Two external blueprints pasted by the principal 2026-09-08 (65 + ~55 items) and five acceptance properties; statuses from six repository sweeps with file:line evidence, checked by scripts/check_tier1_program.py.
heat_policy: 20% portfolio heat is the ceiling AND the floor of the book; never reduced. Tier-1 means more independent positive-Elog bets inside the same heat.

phases.0: Close the truth loop: attribution, deadman, stable adoption, node separation, durable jobs, data freshness, research lineage
phases.1: Remove the research throughput ceiling: worker queue, multi-fidelity screening, EVSI scheduler, research DAG, scalable forward clocks, content-addressed cache, experiment DB
phases.2: Maximum breadth: the eight generators (LLM mechanism, symbolic, evolutionary, RL, residual, regime, causal, execution)
phases.3: Alpha knowledge graph: research, failures, mechanisms, strategies, data, correlations, certificates, live results as one memory
phases.4: Adversarial scientific loop: falsifier, replicator, leakage prosecutor, statistics prosecutor, synthetic nulls, positive controls
phases.5: Adaptive capital brain: regime posterior, decay posterior, joint scenarios, tail dependence, state-dependent Elog, execution-cost prediction, contextual allocation, H <= 20%
phases.6: Execution intelligence: routing competition, slippage prediction, fill probability, self-footprint, broker microstructure
phases.7: Recursive research improvement: agents compete for compute by downstream economic value; the machine redesigns itself

acceptance_properties.name: No fixed discovery frontier
acceptance_properties.measure: A new asset, mechanism, feature, dataset, language, model class, execution idea or research method reaches the docket without a code change: count of frontier cells opened per week by the system itself (hunt_frontier vectors, universe registry additions, data_universe_map entries, new families registered) vs by a human session.

acceptance_properties.name: No unmeasured intelligence
acceptance_properties.measure: Every LLM seat, miner, dataset, generator and infrastructure change has a row with incremental survivors and incremental robust E[log W] attributed to it (compiled artifact per_source/seats, hunt_frontier yield, compute_ledger cost); anything without a row is EXISTS-DARK by definition.

acceptance_properties.name: No semantic breaks
acceptance_properties.measure: A hypothesis id can be followed deterministically source -> compiler row -> gauntlet cell -> certificate -> forward clock -> allocation fraction -> intent -> broker order -> position -> deal -> realized R -> lesson/graph update; measured as the share of closed strategy deals with a complete chain (target 100%).

acceptance_properties.name: The portfolio creates research missions
acceptance_properties.measure: The allocator's unfilled heat and the book's missing exposures (session, regime, factor beta, horizon, drawdown states) are written as missions that generators consume; measured as missions issued per week and candidates tagged with the mission that caused them.

acceptance_properties.name: The machine improves the machine
acceptance_properties.measure: Generators, validators, schedulers and allocation methods run as A/B arms with equal compute and the inferior arm is retired by survivor yield / realized Elog; measured as the number of arms with a recorded verdict.

items.gap: The unused-heat loop is wired at both ends — the allocator's gaps become queue rows and the queue has real consumers — but the mission never names a GENERATOR: all 47,150 queue rows carry `kind: None` and no producer field, so a row saying 'nothing pays in Asia + low vol' cannot be routed to the engine that could answer it. And the half that prices the missing heat is dark: portfolio_gap.py is a scheduled step that has never written reports/portfolio_gap.json, and every rail in MISSED_GROWTH.json reads 'no allocator pass on this host'.
items.next_step: Have `desks/mt5/research/regime_coverage._merge_into_queue` stamp each task with a `target_engine` chosen from `libs/research/bandit.SOURCE_ARM` (e.g. an uncovered state → `conditional_state_edge` → transition_alpha), so the deepening queue's rows address a generator instead of a general audience.
